title: Remote content fetched from a computed URL in php — review required
description: file_get_contents accepts URLs when the HTTP wrapper is enabled, so a computed value makes the server fetch whatever host it names. That reaches loopback services, RFC 1918 hosts and cloud metadata. The rule flags the URL argument; whether it is request-derived is a review decision.
remediation: Allowlist scheme and host, reject private and link-local addresses after resolution, and prefer a hardened HTTP client.
limitation: Lexical: matches file_get_contents with a non-literal argument; URL assembly in a helper is out of scope.
